title: Step 1 has no 'already deployed' checkpoint; a mid-saga re-run silently redeploys V2/temp/migrators (unconditional `new`) and overwrites the deployments bus
rootCause: The five `new` deployments in step 1 (V2 strategies, tempStaker, migrators) are UNCONDITIONAL — there is no 'deployments JSON already present with live-code addresses' checkpoint. A mid-saga re-run mints a fresh contract set and vm.writeJson overwrites ys-swap-deployments.json, while the live phUSD-minter wiring and old-strategy revocation still reference the FIRST set.
impact: No fund loss / no silent corruption. A mid-saga re-run produces a stale deployments bus pointing at un-wired contracts; downstream preflights (code.length, canMint, config-match) catch the mismatch and revert (fail-loud). The stale bus must be manually restored.
attackPath: 1. Steps 1-3 broadcast against the first deployment.
3. Five unconditional `new` deployments mint a fresh contract set; vm.writeJson overwrites the deployments bus.
4. Live wiring still references the first set; downstream steps hit the mismatch and revert (no silent corruption).
5. Operator must manually restore the stale bus.
recommendation: Gate deployment on a 'deployments JSON already present with live-code addresses' check (skip-if-already-deployed), or explicitly document that step 1 is run exactly once and never re-run after step 2.
severityRationale: Low: non-idempotent deploy is an operator footgun whose worst outcome is a stale bus pointing at un-wired contracts, caught fail-loud by downstream guards — no asset loss, no silent corruption. C4 state-handling / drift -> Low. Cross-linked to FIXED YS-13/86a0f4fd: story-062 made the WIRING idempotent; this is the narrower never-closed residual that the five `new` deployments themselves remain unconditional. Tracked as a NEW Low cross-linked to 86a0f4fd, NOT a regression flip — YS-13's fixed scope (wiring-resume + --skip-simulation removal) holds.
footgunRationale: Non-obvious re-run footgun. Safe-config: gate deployment on a deployments-JSON-present check, or document run-exactly-once.
threeLawFraming: Law 3 in-scope non-obvious footgun; Law 1 honest severity Low (fail-loud, no loss). flaggedForHumanReview retained from dedup for the partial-regression judgement call (NOT a regression of YS-13).
relatedNote: Cross-linked to FIXED YS-13 / 86a0f4fd (same deploy entry); narrower never-closed residual, NOT a regression of YS-13.
